description: Routing accuracy corpus — phrases that should/should not activate report-brief. Adversarial cases discriminate it from its near-synonymous siblings (report-strategic, report-state, report-progress), the hard routing boundary flagged in the 2026-05-31 review.
trigger_phrases: CIA-style briefing with BLUF and confidence levels
get me up to speed on [topic] quickly
domain brief for a subject-matter expert
primer on X with key judgments and intelligence gaps
what do I need to know about X
write a brief on the competitive landscape
subject-matter expert brief that survives executive scrutiny
adversarial_phrases: write a full strategic report with glossary and context-setting
strategic analysis for a mixed audience with recommendations
current state of the union for our platform
system health check with a RAG matrix
weekly project status report with blockers and milestones
write the PRD for this feature
notes: Adversarials route to siblings: full strategic/context-setting/recommendation document → report-strategic; current-state/health-matrix → report-state; project/sprint status + blockers + milestones → report-progress; PRD → plan-prd. report-brief owns dense, fast, confidence-annotated knowledge transfer (BLUF, key judgments, intel gaps).
